items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: if Rotherie could play it, I could play it, because I'd just watch him and see how he played it -- and I'd play it.

ctx.x:
Yeah. We played in this restaurant. I learned a lot of music there, because I had a chance to practice every day and play at night. And when you can do that, you can learn, whether you want to or not, because they call lots of different numbers, and if Rotherie could play it, I could play it, because I'd just watch him and see how he played it -- and I'd play it.

So that lasted for a while. Then I decided that I wanted to go... I went down to a little place called Wewoka. That's right down the road about…
What's the name of this town?
